title: Late checkout upgrade offer
description: Offer in-stay upgrades like late checkout on WhatsApp for guests currently at the hotel. Marketing template with a quick reply to accept.
notes: Time it the evening before checkout. Quick-reply acceptance keeps the experience conversational and easy to track.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, would you like to sleep in? Extend your checkout to *{{late_time}}* for just {{price}}. Reply below and we will confirm right away.
